games.name: [UPDATE!] Madness: Project Nevada Remastered
games.desc:
Project Nevada Remastered is a difficult PVP game, it is expected to constantly die.

Use codes: MiniUpdateRelease!, 3MIL!, SRRYFORDELAY! FOR INGAME REWARDS

The year is 2008. The sun is pale as always, the rents due, weapons are cheap, but most of all; today's garbage day, and you've got a lot of trash to take out.

Project Nevada Remastered is an open-ended game set in the Madness Combat universe about doing whatever you want, and how you please. Go around doing contracts for cash, be a general nuisance for nothing but kicks, be a janitor if you so desire. Become a respected SNPD officer you've always wanted to become or be the vigilante protagonist your ego always told you that you were.

CONTROLS:
-CTRL = Run
-F = Block
-R = Heavy attack
-Q = Dash

 
Make sure to join our communication server in order to not miss out on potential updates and keep track of Project Nevada's news!
